correctness.rationale: The octagon is [-1,1]² minus four right corner triangles of legs a; for every nonzero integer frequency the square contribution vanishes. Summing four triangle integrals gives -4 ∫_0^a∫_0^(a-u) cos(2πm u)cos(2πn v)dvdu. Elementary integration yields the displayed off-diagonal quotient, with a separate derivative/continuous limit for m=±n. Cosine equality gives a(m±n) integer; diagonal sine zero requires 2am integer. Hence irrational a has no nonzero integer zeros; rational p/q has exactly the stated congruence lines with diagonal exceptions. Residue-class inclusion–exclusion yields the exact finite count and limiting nonzero density. Unit-cell periodization removes four triangles of area a²/2; their only positive-area intersections are four adjacent pairs of area (a-1/2)_+², no triple intersections. Coverage probabilities follow from first two moments and W=4−X, and torus Parseval gives the energy as Var(X). Independently checked rational congruence zeros over q=2..15, m,n from -7..7 and midpoint coverage at multiple apertures; these sample checks do not replace the all-frequency integration/proof.
